components.name: Header Control
components.description: Compact square control for menu and theme actions.
components.css: .ds-header-control{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;padding:0;border:1px solid #343638;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:#e3e4e6;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-header-control svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2}.ds-header-control:hover{border-color:#2c9cff;background:#2a2c2f}.ds-header-control:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#2c9cff 72%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Sidebar Active Link
components.description: Current Markdown page in the document tree.

components.name: Category Card
components.description: Generated link to one immediate child Markdown page.
components.html: AccessibilityOpen document
components.css: .ds-category-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:92px;padding:20px;border:1px solid #343638;border-radius:10px;background:#1e1f20;color:#e3e4e6;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out}.ds-category-card span:last-child{display:grid;gap:5px}.ds-category-card small{color:#a5a9af}.ds-category-card:hover{border-color:#2c9cff;transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-category-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,#2c9cff 72%,transparent);outline-offset:2px}.ds-card-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:#25384b;color:#2c9cff}.ds-card-icon svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-width:1.8}

narrative.overview: DLCE Docs is a restrained documentation workspace with graphite surfaces, clean paper surfaces, and one established blue used to communicate location and action.
keyCharacteristics: One blue accent with neutral layered surfaces

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue communicates navigation and interaction; do not introduce unrelated accent colors for ordinary controls.

rules.name: The Reading-First Rule
rules.body: Use the display scale once per document; navigation never competes with the page H1.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add persistent card shadows to documentation navigation; use border and tone first.

dos: Do keep global, document, and in-page navigation visually separate.
Do obtain UI strings from the language dictionaries.
Do preserve the established blue and transparent DLCE artwork.
donts: Don't place H2/H3 links back inside the Markdown page tree.
Don't hard-code new interface copy in navigation logic.
Don't add gradients or unrelated accent colors.
